```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(VGAM)
library(knitr)
library(NHANES)
```

## Data Preparation

```{r}
data(NHANES)

df <- NHANES %>%
  mutate(
    HealthNum = case_when(
      HealthGen == "Excellent" ~ 1,
      HealthGen == "Vgood" ~ 2,
      HealthGen == "Good" ~ 3,
      HealthGen == "Fair" ~ 4,
      HealthGen == "Poor" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Health = ordered(HealthNum, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)),
    Age = as.numeric(Age),
    Gender = factor(Gender),
    BMI = as.numeric(BMI),
    Smoking = factor(SmokeNow)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Health, Age, Gender, BMI, Smoking) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  droplevels()

summary(df)
```

## Prediction Data for Parallel Model

```{r}
newdata_parallel <- data.frame(
  Age = seq(min(df$Age), max(df$Age), length.out = 100),
  Gender = factor(rep(levels(df$Gender)[1], 100), levels = levels(df$Gender)),
  BMI = rep(mean(df$BMI, na.rm = TRUE), 100),
  Smoking = factor(rep(levels(df$Smoking)[1], 100), levels = levels(df$Smoking))
)

head(newdata_parallel)
```


## Parallel Cumulative Logit Model

```{r}
parallel_model <- vglm(
  Health ~ Age + Gender + BMI + Smoking,
  family = cumulative(link = "logitlink", parallel = TRUE),
  data = df,
  model = TRUE
)

summary(parallel_model)
```


## Plot for Parallel Model

```{r}
pred_parallel <- predict(parallel_model, newdata = newdata_parallel, type = "response")

plot_parallel <- cbind(newdata_parallel, as.data.frame(pred_parallel)) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("Age", "Gender", "BMI", "Smoking", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
    names_to = "Health",
    values_to = "Probability"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Health = factor(
      Health,
      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      labels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")
    ),
    Model = "Parallel"
  )

ggplot(plot_parallel, aes(x = Age, y = Probability, color = Health)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Parallel Cumulative Logit Model",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```




## Non-Parallel Cumulative Logit Model

```{r}
nonparallel_model <- vglm(
  Health ~ Age + BMI+ Gender+ Smoking,
  family = cumulative(link = "logitlink", parallel = FALSE),
  data = df,
  model = TRUE
)

nonparallel_model
```

## Prediction Data for Non-Parallel Model

```{r}
newdata_nonparallel <- data.frame(
  Age = seq(min(df$Age), max(df$Age), length.out = 100),
  BMI = rep(mean(df$BMI, na.rm = TRUE), 100),
  Gender = factor(rep(levels(df$Gender)[1], 100), levels = levels(df$Gender)),
  Smoking = factor(rep(levels(df$Smoking)[1], 100), levels = levels(df$Smoking))
)

pred_nonparallel <- predictvglm(
  nonparallel_model,
  newdata = newdata_nonparallel,
  type = "response"
)

pred_nonparallel <- as.data.frame(pred_nonparallel)
colnames(pred_nonparallel) <- c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5")
```


## Plot for Non-Parallel Model

```{r}
plot_nonparallel <- cbind(newdata_nonparallel, as.data.frame(pred_nonparallel)) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("Age", "BMI","Gender", "Smoking", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
    names_to = "Health",
    values_to = "Probability"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Health = factor(
      Health,
      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      labels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")
    ),
    Model = "Non-parallel"
  )

ggplot(plot_nonparallel, aes(x = Age, y = Probability, color = Health)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Non-Parallel Cumulative Logit Model",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


## Model Comparison

```{r}
AIC(parallel_model)
AIC(nonparallel_model)

BIC(parallel_model)
BIC(nonparallel_model)
```




## Combined Plot

```{r}
plot_both <- bind_rows(plot_parallel, plot_nonparallel)

ggplot(plot_both, aes(x = Age, y = Probability, color = Health)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Model) +
  labs(
    title = "Parallel vs Non-Parallel Cumulative Logit Models",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
